title: weigela × fujisanensis var. rosea
intro: Weigela × fujisanensis var. rosea, commonly known as Weigela rosea, is a deciduous shrub native to East Asia, belonging to the family Ericaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in medicine and is known for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, colds, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Weigela rosea include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antipyretic properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Weigela rosea include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
